name: Hulkling

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Pierce: Blok Nüfuzunu ve Zırh Nüfuzunu belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Aptitude: Fury, Armor Up ve Precision etkilerinin gücünü artırır.
abilityDetails.Intimidate: Blok şansını artırır, blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Indestructible, engellenemez, iyileşme ve blok-nüfuzu — hepsi bonus, nötralize/nötrleştirici şampiyonlar kolayca kapatır.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Advanced Kree-Skrull physiology provides full immunity to the Poisons and Shocks of the Battlerealm.
Additionally, the mystical Excelsior Sword protects Hulkling's energy, granting immunity to Power Drain, Steal and Burn, and reducing incoming Heal Block duration by 2 second(s) flat.
When Hulkling prevents an effect via immunity, he gains 1 Shapeshift Charge(s).
Offensive Combat Power Rate is decreased by 20%.
+[2,664.25] Attack Rating for each unique Buff Hulkling has.

abilitySections.title: Shapeshift Charges - Max 8
content: Start the fight with 3 Shapeshift Charge(s), and gain 1 Charge(s) every 1 second(s) while not attacking with Basic Attacks or being Struck.
A Shapeshift Charge is converted into a Buff when Hulkling performs certain gameplay actions. These Buffs each last 16 second(s) and can stack up to 4 times.
Whenever a Shapeshift Buff is gained, Hulkling also Passively gains 7% of a Bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Shapeshift Buff Conversion
content: Hit into Block: Convert into a Pierce Buff of [916.67] potency.
Strike with a Light or Medium Attack: Convert into an Aptitude Buff, increasing the potency of Fury, Armor, and Precision Buffs by 18%.
Well-Timed Block: Convert into a Bulwark Buff, increasing Block Proficiency by [916.67].
Struck by the Opponent: Convert into a Regeneration Buff, healing 65% of the damage taken from the Strike.

abilitySections.title: Peak Transformation
content: Every 5 Pierce Buffs gained also grants an Unblockable Buff for 5 second(s). Reduced to every 3 Buffs when fighting as a Defender.
Every 8 Regeneration Buffs gained also grants an Indestructible Buff for 2.5 second(s). Reduced to every 5 Buffs when fighting as a Defender.
If either of these Buffs are Nullified, they are replaced with identical Passives, and their duration is 3 second(s) longer.
Both the Indestructible Buff and Passive are removed after being struck by the Opponent's Special Attack 3.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Inflicts a non-stacking Intimidate Debuff for 7 second(s), making the Opponent less aggressive and reducing their Block Proficiency by [1,178.57]. Cooldown 15 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: For the next 10 second(s), the time between gaining Shapeshift Charges is decreased to 0.5 second(s).
If Hulkling is or becomes Unblockable during this Attack, pause all his personal Buffs, other than Unblockable, until 2 second(s) after this Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On Activation, gain a Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by [7,459.9] for 10 second(s).
If Hulkling is or becomes Unblockable during this Attack, gain another Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by [11,722.7] for 10 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If Hulkling has at least 2 Bulwark Shapeshift Buffs, pause 2 of them for the remainder of the fight, once per fight.
If Hulkling doesn't have enough Bulwark, or they're already paused, pause Aptitude Buffs instead, then Pierce Buffs.
If Hulkling doesn't have enough of any Bulwark, Aptitude, or Pierce, or all are paused, he instead gains Shapeshift Charges up to their Max.
